# Copilot persistent workspace

This file exists only to keep the permanent `copilot` working branch and its draft PR alive as the GitHub Copilot laboratory for Hoarbound.

- Branch: `copilot`
- Base: `main`
- Purpose: isolated R&D, tooling spikes, validation, and reports.
- Do not merge this draft PR wholesale.
- Proven changes should be reviewed and integrated deliberately by the repository owner.
- Copilot must obey `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `docs/technical/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
